Laura Isel   Hello! &nbsp;I’m Laura, the founder of Laura &amp; Co. Salon. I have been behind the chair since 2001. I Started my career in Pennsylvania (Let’s go Steelers) cruised through the Pacific with the London based company Steiner Ltd. and continued my career here in Myrtle. &nbsp;I had many years of training through Davines, Brazilian Blowout and more recently with several Balayage experts. I like to hear what your ideas, likes, dislikes, preferences, and opinions about your hair before I create a fab new look for you. I love to create custom fashion colors in combination with using Balayage and other color techniques. &nbsp;&nbsp;  When I’m not behind the chair.. I’m with my husband and two boys, enjoying the water, good food, and all the perks of living in Myrtle Beach. I also enjoy succulents and my fur babies:-)  &nbsp;Hours: Tues, Thurs, Fri and some Saturdays&nbsp;10a-6p.  By appointment only.
